9.4 Communication request
Figure 9.4 shows the possibilities to start COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION on CAN. It
can be either initiated if a user requests COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION request or
DCM indicates ComM_DCM_ActiveDiagnostic (see [SWS_ComM_00873]).
The
behaviour is equal for LIN, FlexRay and Ethernet just with different API names.
